translation: n. 潜力；可能性 | adj. 潜在的，可能的
definitionEn:
(1) n. the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect
(2) n. a natural ability or quality that shows someone or something will be successful
(3) n. likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 潜在的，可能的（常作定语，修饰名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: A potential agent was sitting in the third row. 一位潜在的经纪人正坐在第三排。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【物理】电位，电势（不可数，学科术语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The device measures the electric potential across the cell. 该仪器测量电池两端的电位。

readingExamples: Most importantly, your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential.

posExamples.sentence: The moment she stepped onto the stage, a hush fell over the audience — it was as if everyone sensed the raw potential radiating from this unknown girl. （读后续写·人物出场）
I am writing to express my sincere belief that with proper guidance, every student in our class has the potential to excel in the upcoming speech contest. （应用文·建议信）
Unbeknown to the young pianist, a potential agent was sitting in the third row, captivated by every note.

wordForms.other: 构词法·后缀：potent（有效的，强有力的）+ -ial→potential；名词与形容词同形，靠位置区分——冠词/物主代词后作名词(your potential)，名词前作定语(potential danger)。副词 potentially = possibly。注意："潜力"义不可数，不说 a potential/potentials。

idioms.example: It was not until Mr. Chen took him under his wing that Li Wei began to fulfil the potential that had lain dormant for so many years. （读后续写·师生关系）

collocations.phrase: have the potential for sth / to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】有……的潜力；有可能做某事（n. possibility that sth will develop）
collocations.example: The company certainly has the potential for growth. 那家公司当然有发展潜力。／The technology has the potential to change our transportation systems and our cities. 这项技术有可能改变我们的交通系统和城市。
Hard work will help you achieve / fulfil / realize your full potential. 努力将帮助你发挥全部潜力。

collocations.phrase: a potential candidate / threat / risk / benefit
collocations.translation: 【课件】潜在的人选／威胁／风险／益处（adj. likely to develop in the future）
collocations.example: For the first time she realized the potential threat of her situation. 她第一次意识到自己处境的潜在威胁。
The advertisement targets new ways of attracting potential customers. 这则广告着眼于吸引潜在客户的新途径。

collocations.translation: 【课件】潜在的危险／问题／副作用
collocations.example: The potential side effects of the drug are unknown. 这种药的潜在副作用尚不清楚。

collocations.phrase: open the door to your potential
collocations.translation: 开启你潜能的大门（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Your time and effort will open the door to your potential. 你付出的时间和努力将开启你潜能的大门。

collocations.translation: 实现／发挥某人的潜力（课文主题搭配）
collocations.example: Hard work helped her realize her full potential. 勤奋让她充分发挥了潜力。
The workshop helped her tap into a creative potential she never knew she possessed. 工作坊帮她发掘出自己从不知道的创作潜力。
The programme holds enormous potential for broadening students' horizons. 这个项目在开阔学生视野方面潜力巨大。
The small startup showed remarkable potential for growth. 这家小公司展现出惊人的成长潜力。

collocations.phrase: a potential candidate / threat / risk / benefit
collocations.translation: 潜在的人选 / 威胁 / 风险 / 益处
collocations.example: The researchers identified several potential benefits. 研究者发现了几项潜在益处。
A good campaign can attract many potential customers. 好的宣传能吸引许多潜在客户。
Parents should be aware of the potential dangers of too much screen time. 家长应注意长时间看屏幕的潜在危险。
Read the label to learn about potential side effects. 读标签了解潜在副作用。

synonyms.example: The young athlete showed great promise, and his coach whispered to a colleague, 'Mark my words — this boy will go far.' （读后续写·动作对话）
synonyms.usage: 侧重预示未来的积极信号，适用于续写中埋下伏笔

synonyms.example: I believe every participant has the capacity to contribute meaningfully to this volunteer project. （应用文·招募信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重内在能力和限度

advancedExpressions.expression: realize / fulfil / reach / tap into / unlock one's potential; live up to one's potential
advancedExpressions.example: Only through consistent effort can one truly unlock the potential that lies dormant within. 唯有持之以恒，才能真正释放沉睡于内心的潜能。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·比喻性未来结构（从课文open the door句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: 主语 + will open the door to sth（正常语序、无倒装；以"打开大门"隐喻未来必然结果）
advancedExpressions.example: Your time and effort at senior high school will open the door to your potential. 你在高中付出的时间与努力，将为你的潜能打开大门。

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. realize the potential within
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did she realize the potential within — a strength she had never known was there. （倒装+隐喻，续写结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: given the potential of ..., it is advisable that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given the potential of this programme to transform our reading habits, it is highly advisable that every student participate actively. （倡议信结尾呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: the potential ... far outweighs ...
advancedExpressions.example: The potential benefits of AI-assisted learning far outweigh its perceived risks — provided that ethical safeguards are firmly in place.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It dawned on her, slowly at first and then all at once, that the potential she had spent years searching for in others had been quietly residing within herself all along — waiting, like a seed beneath winter soil, for the right moment to break through. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It dawned on sb. that...心理觉醒 + 比喻(seed beneath winter soil) + 副词节奏控制(slowly...then all at once)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore my firm conviction that our school should establish a mentorship programme through which every student's unique potential can be identified, nurtured, and ultimately brought to full fruition. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that...正式主句 + through which定语从句 + 三动词递进(identified, nurtured, brought)

translation: 迫不及待（做某事）；等不及
definitionEn:
(1) phr. used to say that someone is very excited about something and eager for it to happen
(2) phr. to be very eager or impatient to do something
readingExamples: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like.

posExamples.sentence: On the first day of school, Jenny could hardly sleep the night before — she simply couldn't wait to meet her new classmates and explore the campus that had appeared in her dreams all summer. （读后续写·心理描写）
I can't wait to show you around our city when you arrive next month. Looking forward to your visit! （应用文·书信结尾）

wordForms.other: 结构注记：can't/couldn't wait + to do（做某事）或 + for sth（等某事）；否定形式表"迫不及待"，实为反话正说——can't wait 字面"等不了"=非常想。同义表达：be dying to do / be itching to do / be eager to do / look forward to doing。注意 look forward to 的 to 是介词接 doing，而 can't wait to 的 to 接原形。

collocations.phrase: can't wait to do sth = can hardly wait to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】迫不及待地要去做某事
collocations.example: She couldn't wait to open the letter. = She could hardly wait to open the letter. 她迫不及待地想拆开那封信。

collocations.translation: 迫不及待做某事（课文原句结构：can't wait to describe）
collocations.example: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like. 我迫不及待想向你描述高中生活是什么样的。

collocations.phrase: can't wait to see / hear / meet...
collocations.translation: 等不及要见到/听到/见到……
collocations.example: I can't wait to see the look on her face. 我等不及想看她脸上的表情。

collocations.phrase: can hardly wait (for sth / to do sth)
collocations.translation: 几乎等不及（比 can't wait 语气更强）
collocations.example: The children could hardly wait for the bell to ring. 孩子们几乎等不及铃声响起。
Every senior said they couldn't wait for the exam to be over. 每个高三生都说等不及考试结束。

synonyms.translation: 极想做某事（口语，情感最强）
synonyms.example: He was dying to ask her to the prom. 他极想邀请她去舞会。
synonyms.usage: 非正式口语，语气最强；结构 be dying to do / be dying for sth。与 can't wait to do 近义可互换，但更夸张。

synonyms.example: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon. 我期待尽快收到你的回信。
synonyms.usage: 较正式，to 为介词，后接名词或动名词（doing），不接动词原形；can't wait 更口语、情感更强，to 后接动词原形。

synonyms.example: The volunteers were eager to contribute their time. 志愿者们渴望贡献时间。
synonyms.usage: 偏书面，be eager to do sth / be eager for sth，强调积极主动的态度与内心渴望。

synonyms.translation: 心痒难耐想做某事（口语）
synonyms.example: She was itching to tell him the news. 她心痒难耐地想告诉他这消息。
synonyms.usage: 口语化，比 can't wait 更有"按捺不住"的意味，多用于续写心理描写。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·can't help doing / can't help but do（课件关联辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: can't help doing sth. / can't help but do sth（忍不住／不可避免做某事）VS can't help (to) do sth.（不能帮助做某事）
advancedExpressions.example: She couldn't help wondering what he was thinking. = She couldn't help but wonder what he was thinking. 她忍不住想知道他在想什么。／I can't help (to) organize the party — you'd better ask someone else. 我帮不了你筹办派对——你最好另找他人帮忙。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表急切期待，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: can't wait to do / be dying to do / be itching to do / be eager to do / look forward to doing / count down the days until
advancedExpressions.example: I can't wait to see you again — honestly, I've been counting down the days until your arrival. 我迫不及待想再见到你——说真的，我一直在倒数你到来的日子。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·宾语从句（从课文describe...what句长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: can't wait to describe/tell/show + sb + what/how...（间接引语作宾语，用陈述语序）
advancedExpressions.example: I can't wait to describe to you what senior high school life is like. 我迫不及待想告诉你高中生活是什么样。

advancedExpressions.expression: I am counting down the days until...
advancedExpressions.example: I am counting down the days until your arrival — the guest room is already prepared! （书信·表达热切期待）

advancedExpressions.expression: the anticipation was almost unbearable
advancedExpressions.example: The night before the competition, the anticipation was almost unbearable — she tossed and turned, her mind racing. （读后续写·赛前紧张心理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I can't wait to see you.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The thought of seeing you again fills me with such excitement that the days ahead seem to stretch into an eternity of waiting. （书信·情感升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词作主语(The thought...) + such...that...结果状语从句 + 夸张(an eternity of waiting)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her fingers trembled with barely contained anticipation as she reached for the ribbon — every second of delay felt like an exquisite torment. （读后续写·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 具体动作描写(trembled, reached) + 抽象心理名词(anticipation, torment) + 破折号展开细节

translation: adj. 中学的（招收11或13岁以上学生）；级别高的；高级水平的；老年的 | n. 级别（或地位）较高者；较…年长的人；高水平运动员
definitionEn:
(1) adj. high in rank or status, or higher in rank than someone else
(2) adj. relating to or intended for older students, especially those at the later stage of secondary school
(3) adj. (of people) old; having reached the later years of life
(4) n. someone who is older or higher in rank than someone else; (AmE) a student in the final year of high school or college

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美国）高中或大学的毕业班学生
uncommonMeanings.example: As a senior facing the college application season, Jason flipped through the yearbook late at night. 作为面临大学申请季的毕业班学生，Jason 深夜翻看着毕业纪念册。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 级别（或地位）较高者；较年长的人
uncommonMeanings.example: She was ten years my senior. 她比我年长十岁。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 高水平运动员（成年组选手）
uncommonMeanings.example: He now competes with the seniors rather than the juniors. 他现在与成年组而非青少年组选手同场竞技。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （置于同名父子中父亲的名字后）老…，大…（缩写 Sr.）
uncommonMeanings.example: The sign still read 'Thomas Baker, Senior'. 招牌上仍写着"老托马斯·贝克"。

readingExamples: Welcome to senior high school!

posExamples.sentence: On my first day at senior high school, I stood frozen at the gate, clutching my schedule so tightly that the paper crumpled, until a warm voice behind me said, 'Lost? Follow me.' （读后续写·开学第一天·紧张与善意）
I am writing to invite you, as a senior engineer with rich hands-on experience, to deliver a lecture on artificial intelligence to the members of our science club next Friday afternoon. （应用文·邀请信）

Respecting our seniors is not merely a matter of politeness; it is a recognition that their experience, accumulated over decades of trial and error, remains a precious resource for the younger generation. （议论文·尊老美德）
It is high time that more volunteers visited the local nursing home, for many senior citizens there long not for material comfort but for simple companionship and a patient listener. （议论文·老龄化社会）

wordForms.noun: seniority（资历；年长）；senior（较年长者/毕业班学生）
wordForms.other: 构词/易错注记：反义词 junior（junior high school 初中 vs senior high school 高中；be junior to sb 职位低于某人）。核心考点——be senior/junior to sb 用介词 to，绝不用 than。senior citizen = 老年人（委婉）；Sr.=老…（用于父名后）。名词 seniority 指"工龄/资历"。

idioms.translation: （幽默）一时健忘，老年失神的瞬间
idioms.example: Grandpa patted every pocket for the glasses that were perched on his own head, then chuckled, 'Forgive me — just having a senior moment.' （读后续写·祖孙温情·幽默细节）

collocations.translation: 高中（课文原句词块：Welcome to senior high school!）
collocations.example: Welcome to senior high school! 欢迎来到高中！

collocations.translation: 职位/资历高于某人；比某人年长（用 to，不用 than！）
collocations.example: Ms. Lin is senior to me in the department. 林女士在部门里资历比我高。
The bus offers free seats to senior citizens. 公交车为老年人提供免费座位。
Our club pays weekly visits to senior citizens nearby. 我们社团每周探访附近的老年人。

collocations.translation: 高级职位／高级官员／高管
collocations.example: Years of dedication earned her a senior position. 多年的投入让她赢得了高级职位。
The senior members coached the newcomers patiently. 资深成员耐心指导新人。

collocations.translation: 毕业年级那一年（高三／大四）
collocations.example: In his senior year, the exam loomed ever larger. 到了毕业年级，考试的压力越来越大。
She is my senior by ten years. 她比我大十岁。
Our proposal was received well by senior management. 我们的提议受到高层管理人员的好评。

synonyms.example: She is my elder sister; she is also senior to me at work. 她是我姐姐，工作上资历也比我高。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：elder 只指血亲/家庭中年长（elder brother），作定语常前置，不与 than 连用；senior 侧重级别/资历，且 be senior to sb 用介词 to（≠ than）。要说"比…年长"用 be senior to sb 或 be older than sb，不说 senior than。

synonyms.example: She wisely consulted her immediate superior. 她明智地请教了直属上级。
synonyms.usage: superior 强调等级上的"上级"，可作名词指"上司"，be superior to sb（也用 to），隐含权力关系；senior 兼指年长与资历深，语气更中性温和。

synonyms.example: An elderly gentleman gave up his seat. 一位上了年纪的先生让了座。
synonyms.usage: elderly 是描述老年人的委婉形容词，只指年龄，作定语；senior 表"老年的"多用于 senior citizen 等固定说法，另有"级别高、资深"义。

synonyms.example: The school offers advanced courses in programming. 学校开设高级编程课程。
synonyms.usage: advanced 指水平、阶段或技术"高级、领先"（advanced learners）；senior 指人的级别、资历或年龄，不形容技术水平。

advancedExpressions.expression: senior high school; senior citizen; senior management/position; be senior to sb; one's senior year; senior by X years
advancedExpressions.example: As a senior citizen, my grandfather is senior to everyone in our reading club by at least twenty years. 作为一位老人，我爷爷在读书会里比谁都至少年长二十岁。

advancedExpressions.expression: junior high school ↔ senior high school; be junior to sb ↔ be senior to sb（均用 to）
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you are junior or senior to your classmates, respect is a two-way street. 无论你比同学资历高还是低，尊重都是双向的。

advancedExpressions.expression: It was not until ... that sb. truly understood what it meant to be a senior student
advancedExpressions.example: It was not until I helped a tearful freshman find her classroom that I truly understood what it meant to be a senior student. （not until 强调句+破折号点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: As a senior ... with ... experience, you are undoubtedly the ideal person to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a senior editor with over a decade of experience, you are undoubtedly the ideal person to judge our writing contest. （身份+资历恭维式开场）

advancedExpressions.expression: Whether junior or senior, ... share(s) the responsibility of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whether junior or senior, every member of society shares the responsibility of caring for the environment. （whether 让步结构+拟人收束）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The senior students did not simply show us around; they walked beside us through every corridor of confusion, turning our nervous first week into a journey of belonging. （读后续写·校园互助）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not simply... 否定引出递进 + 抽象名词具体化(corridor of confusion) + turning 现在分词表结果，化叙述为画面

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As a senior high school student standing at the crossroads between adolescence and adulthood, I am learning to shoulder responsibilities that once seemed far beyond me. （应用文·自我介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 介词短语开篇亮明身份 + crossroads 隐喻定位人生阶段 + that 定语从句体现成长弧线

classPractice.note: junior high 初中，senior high 高中，一对反义词。

classPractice.answer: Our club pays weekly visits to senior citizens nearby. / Our club visits senior citizens in the neighbourhood every week.
classPractice.note: senior citizen(s) = 老年人，比 old people 更委婉得体。

definitionEn:
(1) n. a way or track that is built or made by people walking over the ground
(2) n. the direction or route along which someone or something moves
(3) n. a set of actions, especially ones that lead to a goal or result (a course of action)

idioms.translation: 与某人不期而遇；偶然相遇

As the first person in her family to attend university, she was blazing a path that her younger siblings would one day follow with far fewer obstacles. （读后续写·励志成长）

idioms.translation: 最省力的途径，阻力最小的道路

Most tourists flocked to the well-known spots, but she ventured off the beaten path and discovered a hidden waterfall that none of the guidebooks had mentioned — and it was there, in that unspoiled corner of the world, that she felt truly alive for the first time in years. （读后续写·探索与发现）
The café he had chosen for our interview was off the beaten track — tucked away in a narrow alley where the only sounds were the occasional bicycle bell and the murmur of an old man reading poetry aloud to no one in particular. （读后续写·场景设定）

idioms.translation: 走前人未走之路，独辟蹊径

collocations.translation: 你面前的道路（课文原句词块）

collocations.translation: 蜿蜒的/陡峭的/崎岖的道路

advancedExpressions.expression: the path to success; career path; cross sb's path; carve out a path; off the beaten path; set sb on the path to; stand in one's path

definitionEn:

(2) v. to be the reason why something happens or exists

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （道路、门等）通向，通往（具体空间义）

posExamples.sentence: A single careless word, spoken in anger, led to a silence between them that stretched into weeks — and it was only when she saw the hurt still lingering in his eyes that she understood how much damage one moment could do. （读后续写·冲突与和解）
I believe that consistent practice rather than last-minute cramming will ultimately lead to better results, and I hope these suggestions prove helpful in your preparation. （应用文·建议信）

collocations.translation: 【课件】导致，引起；（道路）通向（to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不接动词原形）
collocations.example: A path leads to the yard. 有条小路通向庭院。／Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems. 食用过多的糖会引起健康问题。／His actions could lead to him losing his job. 他的行为会让他丢掉工作。

collocations.translation: 【课件】促使／使得某人做某事（这里 lead 后接不定式 to do）

synonyms.translation: 引起，导致（多指抽象事物、问题）

definitionEn:

(2) vt. to question whether something is true, right, or legal

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】质疑；挑战（对……提出异议）

collocations.translation: 勇敢迎接挑战，从容应对难关

collocations.translation: 激/邀某人做某事，向某人发起挑战
collocations.example: He challenged me to finish the race. 他激我跑完全程。
The language barrier posed a challenge to the exchange students. 语言障碍给交换生带来了挑战。
I have decided to take on the challenge of organizing the festival. 我决定接受组织这次节日活动的挑战。
Standing before the judges was a daunting challenge. 站在评委面前是令人生畏的挑战。

synonyms.example: She questioned the fairness of the rule. 她质疑这条规则是否公平。
synonyms.usage: 作"质疑"义时 challenge 语气更强、带公开对抗意味（challenge a theory/decision）；question 只表示提出疑问、心存怀疑，语气较缓。两者均及物。

synonyms.example: The three-day trek through the blizzard was an ordeal. 穿越暴风雪的三天跋涉是一场严峻考验。
synonyms.usage: ordeal 只作名词，强调痛苦而漫长的煎熬；challenge 中性偏积极，可指值得迎接的难题，还可作动词。

synonyms.example: Each hurdle she cleared became a stepping stone. 她跨过的每一道难关都成了垫脚石。
synonyms.usage: hurdle 比喻需要逐一跨越的具体障碍（clear/overcome a hurdle），可数；challenge 范围更广，可指整体性、抽象的挑战。

advancedExpressions.expression: face / meet / rise to / take on / pose / present / overcome a challenge; challenge sb to do; challenge a theory/decision
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of shrinking from the challenge, she chose to rise to it and, in doing so, challenged everyone's low expectations of her. 她没有从挑战面前退缩，而是选择迎难而上，并因此打破了所有人对她的低估。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"挑战/难关"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: challenge / hurdle / obstacle / ordeal / trial / test / difficulty
advancedExpressions.example: Every hurdle, every ordeal, every seemingly impossible challenge became, in hindsight, a lesson in disguise. 每一道难关、每一场煎熬、每一个看似不可能的挑战，事后看来都是伪装的一课。

advancedExpressions.expression: what had once seemed an insurmountable challenge now appeared to be ...
advancedExpressions.example: What had once seemed an insurmountable challenge now appeared to be nothing more than a bend in the road. （前后对比+隐喻收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to challenge the notion that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to challenge the notion that volunteer work is merely a box to tick. （倡议信/演讲稿开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: the greatest challenge lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The greatest challenge of our time lies not in the scarcity of resources but in the poverty of imagination. （否定对比+抽象论证）

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The challenge that stood before him was not one of strength or skill — it was the kind that gnaws at the soul in the quiet hours before dawn, whispering doubts that only the brave dare to silence. （读后续写·内心挣扎）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...对比 + 拟人(gnaws at the soul, whispering doubts) + 时间意象(quiet hours before dawn)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely through confronting challenges — not the comfortable, predictable sort, but those that shake us to our core — that we discover reserves of courage we never knew we possessed. （应用文·感悟类）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that...强调句 + 破折号插入否定递进 + discover reserves of courage名词短语

definitionEn:
(1) n. the process of using your mind to consider or reason about something
(2) n. a particular way of considering or approaching something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】思想，思考，思维（the process of thinking about sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: I have to do some quick thinking. 我得迅速思考一番。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】想法，见解（ideas or opinions about sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: To my way of thinking, we should try again. = In my opinion, we should try again. 依我看，我们应该再试一次。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 思维，思考（作"思维/想法"义时不可数，课文用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The book changed my whole thinking on the subject. 这本书改变了我对这个问题的全部看法。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某群体的）观点，看法，意见
uncommonMeanings.example: Current thinking favours smaller class sizes. 目前的主流看法倾向于小班教学。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有思考能力的，理性的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: She is a thinking person who never accepts conventional wisdom blindly. 她是个爱思考的人，从不盲目接受传统看法。

readingExamples: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking.

posExamples.sentence: As he stood at the edge of the cliff, his thinking began to shift — perhaps this was not an ending, he mused, but the beginning of something he could not yet name. （读后续写·心理转折）
Through this exchange activity, I have not only improved my English but also gained exposure to different ways of thinking, which I believe is the most valuable takeaway. （应用文·活动总结）

wordForms.noun: thinking（思维，不可数）；thought（思想；想法，可数或不可数）；thinker（思想家）
wordForms.adjective: thoughtful（深思的；体贴的）；thought-provoking（发人深省的）；thinking（爱思考的）
wordForms.other: 构词/易错注记：think 加 -ing 构成动名词/名词 thinking，作"思维、思考"义时为不可数名词，不说 a thinking/thinkings。动词 think 过去式-过去分词 thought-thought。搭配 ways of thinking（思维方式）、critical/positive/wishful thinking。合成词 thought-provoking（发人深省的）。

idioms.example: To my way of thinking, the most valuable lesson this experience has taught us is that setbacks are simply detours, not dead ends. （应用文·观点表达）

collocations.translation: 【课件】迅速思考一番，急中生智
collocations.example: I have to do some quick thinking. 我得迅速思考一番。
He laughed and accused me of wishful thinking. 他笑着骂我是一厢情愿。
To my way of thinking, honesty always pays off. 依我看，诚实总有回报。

collocations.translation: 【课件】批判性／分析性／积极的思维
collocations.example: The debate club develops critical, analytical and positive thinking. 辩论社培养批判性、分析性和积极的思维。

collocations.translation: 新的思维方式（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The path before you leads to a world full of challenges: a new environment, new knowledge and new ways of thinking. 你面前的道路通向一个充满挑战的世界：新的环境、新的知识和新的思维方式。
Travel opened her eyes to a completely new way of thinking. 旅行让她看到了一种全新的思维方式。
The debate club has sharpened my critical thinking. 辩论社锻炼了我的批判性思维。

collocations.translation: 积极的思维方式，正面思考
collocations.example: Positive thinking helped her get through the hardest days. 积极的心态帮她熬过了最艰难的日子。
Believing the problem will solve itself is mere wishful thinking. 认为问题会自行解决只是一厢情愿。
A profound shift in his thinking took place that night. 那一晚他的思维发生了深刻转变。

synonyms.example: What changed was not his circumstances but his mindset. 改变的不是他的处境，而是他的心态。
synonyms.usage: mindset 侧重相对固定的思维倾向/心态（a growth mindset），可数；thinking 作"思维"义时不可数，指思考过程或整体想法。

synonyms.example: Her reasoning was so sound that the judge nodded. 她的推理如此严密，评委频频点头。
synonyms.usage: reasoning 强调逻辑推理的过程与链条（不可数）；thinking 更宽泛，泛指思考活动或思想观点。

synonyms.example: A sudden thought struck her. 一个念头突然闪过她的脑海。
synonyms.usage: thought 作"具体念头"时可数（a thought, thoughts），作"思想体系"时不可数（modern thought）；thinking 作"思维方式/思考"不可数，且强调过程。

advancedExpressions.expression: ways of thinking; critical thinking; positive thinking; wishful thinking; a shift in one's thinking; to my way of thinking
advancedExpressions.example: To my way of thinking, cultivating critical thinking matters far more than mere positive thinking or comforting wishful thinking. 依我看，培养批判性思维远比单纯的积极思考或聊以自慰的一厢情愿重要得多。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ing 动名词转名词（不可数）
advancedExpressions.expression: think→thinking（思维/思考，U）；对照可数的 thought（想法）
advancedExpressions.example: New ways of thinking often begin with a single unexpected thought. 新的思维方式往往始于一个意想不到的念头。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·of + doing 作后置定语（从课文ways of thinking长出）
advancedExpressions.expression: n. + of + doing（way of doing sth / means of doing sth）
advancedExpressions.example: Senior high opens the door to new ways of thinking and learning. 高中为你打开通往新思维、新学习方式的大门。

advancedExpressions.expression: a thought crept into one's mind
advancedExpressions.example: A thought crept into his mind — quiet at first, like a distant melody — that perhaps the answer had been there all along. （渐进式心理描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: a growing body of thinking suggests that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A growing body of thinking suggests that creativity should be at the heart of modern education. （引出主流观点）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is worth considering that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we finalize the plan, it is worth considering that a more inclusive approach may yield better participation from junior students. （提议/建议信）

translation: 积极乐观的；良好的，正面的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. thinking about what is good in a situation
(2) adj. feeling confident and hopeful
(3) adj. good or useful
(4) adj. expressing certainty or agreement

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优势，优点
uncommonMeanings.example: As she looked back on the turbulent year, she chose to focus not on what she had lost but on the positives — the friendships forged in hardship, the wisdom gained through pain. （读后续写·反思收束）

readingExamples: However, for those of you with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge.

posExamples.sentence: Her grandmother had always said, 'Find one positive thing in every dark day,' and it was this quiet practice that carried her through the hardest winter of her life. （读后续写·祖辈智慧传承）
The feedback from the exchange programme has been overwhelmingly positive, with participants reporting increased confidence and a deeper appreciation for cultural diversity. （应用文·活动汇报）

wordForms.noun: positive（n. 优点，优势）/ positivity（n. 积极性，正能量）
wordForms.adverb: positively（adv. 积极地；确实地，肯定地）
wordForms.other: 反义词：negative（消极的；否定的；阴性的）。构词：形容词 + -ly → positively，可表"简直，确实"加强语气（It was positively freezing. 简直冻死了）。名词 positive 常用复数 positives 表"优点、好的方面"。

idioms.example: As the rain poured through the leaking tent, she laughed and said, 'Let's look on the bright side — we won't need a shower tonight!' （读后续写·苦中作乐·对话）

collocations.example: You've got to be more positive about your work. 你必须更加积极地对待自己的工作。

collocations.phrase: a positive attitude to / towards sth
collocations.example: She's got a really positive attitude to / towards life. 她对生活抱有非常乐观的态度。

collocations.phrase: have a positive effect on sth
collocations.example: The rural environment has a positive effect on the children's health. 乡村环境对孩子们的健康有好处。
Women should be portrayed in a more positive light. 应该从更正面的角度来描绘女性。

collocations.translation: 【课件】积极的反应／回应／反馈（expressing support）
collocations.example: The proposal met with a very positive response. 这项提议得到了非常积极的回应。
There is positive proof that he was at the scene. 有确凿的证据表明他曾在现场。
Athletes who had tested positive for banned substances were disqualified. 药检呈阳性的运动员被取消资格。
A proton carries a positive charge. 质子带正电荷。
She responded positively to the new plan. 她对新计划反应积极。
For those of you with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge. 对于心态积极的你们，机会就藏在每一个挑战里。
Try to be positive about the future. 试着对未来乐观一些。
I'm positive that I locked the door. 我确信我锁了门。
A positive attitude helps you learn faster. 积极的态度让你学得更快。
Even as the chemotherapy drained her body, she maintained a positive outlook that baffled her doctors and inspired everyone on the ward. （读后续写·疾病/励志）
I am convinced that your participation will have a lasting positive impact on the younger students, who look up to you as a role model. （应用文·邀请信）
It was the teacher's quiet positive reinforcement — a nod here, a word of encouragement there — that slowly coaxed the shy boy out of his shell. （读后续写·师生互动）

synonyms.example: She stayed optimistic about passing the exam. 她对通过考试保持乐观。
synonyms.usage: optimistic 侧重"对未来结果有信心、往好处想"，常搭 optimistic about sth；positive 语义更宽，既指"乐观积极"，也指"确信的、正面的、良好的"，还可作名词表"优点"。谈心态时二者常可换，但"检测呈阳性"只用 positive。

synonyms.example: I'm confident that we can win. 我确信我们能赢。
synonyms.usage: confident 强调"自信、有把握"，可 confident of/about/that；positive 表"确信"时更口语、语气更斩钉截铁（be positive that = 十分肯定，几乎不容置疑）。

synonyms.example: I would appreciate it if you could offer some constructive suggestions on how to improve the layout of our school newspaper. （应用文·请求信）
synonyms.usage: 强调有助益、能促成进步

advancedExpressions.expression: be positive about / be positive that / a positive mind / positive impact / positive attitude / on the positive side
advancedExpressions.example: With a positive mind and a positive attitude, she stayed positive about the result and was positive that hard work would pay off. 心态积极、态度积极，她对结果保持乐观，并确信努力终会有回报。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"确信"）
advancedExpressions.expression: be positive that = be certain / be sure / be convinced / have no doubt that
advancedExpressions.example: I'm positive that he'll come. = I'm certain / convinced that he'll come. 我确信他会来。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·反义前缀 vs 后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: positive ↔ negative（词根不同的反义对）；positive → positively（-ly 副词）→ positivity（-ity 名词）
advancedExpressions.example: Focus on the positives, not the negatives. 多看优点，别只盯着缺点。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. chose to see the positive in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Where others saw only wreckage, she chose to see the positive — a blank canvas upon which something new and beautiful could be built. （废墟vs画布的意象对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: I cannot stress enough the positive difference that ... can make
advancedExpressions.example: I cannot stress enough the positive difference that regular journaling can make — it sharpens thinking, clarifies emotions, and documents growth. （建议信·推荐方法）

advancedExpressions.expression: on the positive side, ...; on the other hand, ...
advancedExpressions.example: On the positive side, social media connects us across continents; on the other hand, it can foster comparison that erodes self-esteem.

definitionEn:
(1) n. a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something
(2) n. a chance for advancement or progress
readingExamples: opportunity lies in each challenge. When you rise to the challenges, you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

posExamples.sentence: The letter lay on the kitchen table, unopened — an opportunity that would alter the course of her life, though she did not yet know it as she poured her morning tea. （读后续写·伏笔悬念）
On behalf of the Student Union, I am delighted to announce an invaluable opportunity: a two-week cultural immersion programme in partnership with our sister school in London. （应用文·通知/公告）

idioms.example: She knew the window of opportunity was narrow — the train would leave in twenty minutes, and with it, her last chance to say what needed to be said. （读后续写·时间紧迫）
When the professor asked for a volunteer, Li Hua seized the opportunity — his hand shooting up before his brain had fully registered the question. （读后续写·动作先行）

definitionEn:

It was through a concerted effort — the villagers forming a human chain, passing buckets from hand to hand — that the fire was finally brought under control. uncommonMeanings.meaning: 预支，预付（款）

synonyms.example: Though the blizzard raged around them, they forged ahead — not because they were fearless, but because someone they loved was waiting on the other side of the mountain. （读后续写·爱驱动前行）

definitionEn:
(1) adj. very surprising, especially in a way that makes you feel pleasure or admiration
(2) adj. extremely good; wonderful
(3) adj. so unexpected or extraordinary that it is difficult to believe
readingExamples: Who knows what beautiful works of art you will create, what medical advances you will make or what amazing technologies you will develop!

posExamples.sentence: When the curtain finally rose, an amazing scene unfolded before us: hundreds of paper cranes, folded by the whole class in secret, drifted down like snow onto the brightly lit stage. （读后续写·惊喜场面·环境描写）
I am delighted to share the amazing news that our school orchestra has been invited to perform at the city concert hall, and I sincerely hope you can come and cheer for us. （应用文·分享喜讯的邮件）
It is amazing how a single act of kindness, small as a dropped coin, can set off ripples that travel far beyond anything the giver ever imagines. （议论文·善意的力量）

The old craftsman's hands, wrinkled yet perfectly steady, moved with amazing precision, carving lifelike petals out of a plain block of wood while we watched, hardly daring to breathe. （读后续写·匠人技艺·细节描写）

wordForms.adjective: amazing（令人惊奇的，修饰物）/ amazed（感到惊奇的，修饰人）

collocations.translation: 对……感到惊奇（-ed 修饰人）
collocations.example: We were all amazed at his progress. 我们都对他的进步感到惊奇。
I was amazed to see how much the town had changed. 我惊讶地看到这座小镇变化如此之大。
Volunteering at the sports meeting was an amazing experience that taught me more about teamwork than any textbook ever could. （应用文·活动感悟）
It is amazing how quickly the desert blooms after a single night of rain, as if life had been waiting patiently underground all along. （读后续写·自然描写·拟人）

collocations.translation: 绝对令人惊叹的（amazing 为强义形容词，用 absolutely 而非 very 修饰）

Winning first prize in the national contest was an amazing achievement for a team that had been founded only six months before. （应用文·校园喜报）
The new library offers an amazing variety of resources, from ancient maps to virtual-reality science labs, catering to readers of every possible interest. （应用文·宣传稿）
Foreign visitors often find it amazing that a city so fiercely modern still preserves its centuries-old tea houses in quiet corners. （议论文·传统与现代）
The children watched in amazement as the paper dragon, lifted by a hundred pairs of hands, seemed to come alive above the festival crowd. （读后续写·节日场面）

synonyms.example: The amazed students stared at the amazing magic trick in silence. 惊奇的学生们默默地盯着那令人惊叹的魔术。
synonyms.usage: 核心辨析(-ing vs -ed)：amazing 修饰"令人惊奇的事物"（an amazing技术/景象），amazed 修饰"感到惊奇的人"（be amazed at sth）；口诀"物用-ing，人用-ed"；同类 interesting/interested, exciting/excited

synonyms.example: The results of the experiment were so astonishing that the professor repeated it three times before daring to publish them. （议论文·科学求证）

synonyms.example: What is truly remarkable about her progress is that it was achieved not by talent alone but by two hundred early mornings. （议论文·勤奋主题）

synonyms.example: Standing on the glass bridge, we drank in the breathtaking scenery below, where a silver river threaded its way through folds of green. （读后续写·写景）
synonyms.usage: 专指美得让人屏住呼吸的景色、表演或速度，是续写写景的首选；不用于形容消息或成绩

synonyms.example: It seemed incredible that the tiny seed we had almost thrown away should grow into the tallest sunflower in the garden. （读后续写·意外之喜）

advancedExpressions.expression: confidence / confident / confidential / confide / confidant

definitionEn: phr. to use or enjoy something as much as possible, especially an opportunity, a resource, or a situation that may not last long
readingExamples: To fully realize your potential, it is important for you to make the most of our school resources.

posExamples.sentence: With only three days left in the village, she made the most of every hour — recording her grandmother's stories, sketching the old courtyard, breathing in the scent of jasmine that would haunt her memory for years to come. （读后续写·告别·珍惜当下）
I would strongly advise all new students to make the most of the mentorship programme — it is a rare chance to learn directly from seniors who have walked the path you are about to tread. （应用文·建议信）

wordForms.other: 短语结构 make the most of + sth（最高级 most 前必须有 the）；辨析三兄弟：make the most of（把好条件用足）/ make the best of（坏条件下尽力）/ make full use of（充分利用，最中性）；of 后接名词或 what 从句（make the most of what you have）；过去式 made the most of

collocations.phrase: make the most of school resources
collocations.translation: 充分利用学校资源（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It is important for you to make the most of our school resources. 你们充分利用学校资源很重要。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make the most of an opportunity
collocations.example: You should make the most of every chance to practise English. 你应该充分利用每一次练习英语的机会。

collocations.phrase: make the most of the time
collocations.example: The old man knew his days were numbered, but instead of despair, he made the most of the time he had — teaching his grandson everything he knew about woodcarving, one patient lesson at a time. （读后续写·生死/传承主题）

collocations.phrase: make the most of what you have
collocations.example: She had no studio, no expensive equipment — just a borrowed camera and a fierce determination to make the most of what she had. And somehow, that was enough. （读后续写·创业/梦想类）

synonyms.translation: （在不利条件下）尽量利用，随遇而安
synonyms.example: The hotel was far from what they had hoped, but they decided to make the best of it and enjoy the trip anyway. 旅馆远不如预期，但他们决定随遇而安，尽情享受旅程。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：make the most of 指"把好条件用到极致"（中性偏积极）；make the best of (a bad job / it) 强调"在坏条件下尽力而为"，含无奈色彩；二者都接 of + 名词

synonyms.example: To prepare for the exam, she made full use of every online resource available. 为备考，她充分利用了每一份在线资源。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：make full use of ≈ make the most of，最中性通用，突出"充分"；结构 make full use of sth / make the most of sth 可互换；注意 use 此处为名词（/juːs/）

synonyms.example: The young entrepreneur capitalized on the sudden interest in traditional crafts, turning her grandmother's embroidery skills into a business that would revive the entire village. （读后续写·时代机遇）
synonyms.usage: 侧重从某事物中获取利益，适合商业/社会主题；比 make the most of 更书面、更强调"抓机遇获利"

synonyms.example: He had spent too many years putting things off, waiting for the 'right moment' that never arrived — but as he stood before the mountain at dawn, he decided it was time to seize the day. （读后续写·人生转折）
synonyms.usage: 经典文学表达，适合续写中的人生感悟和转折点

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"充分利用")
advancedExpressions.expression: make the most of = make full use of = take (full) advantage of = capitalize on = make the best of（坏条件下）
advancedExpressions.example: You should make the most of / make full use of / take full advantage of every learning resource the school offers. （前三者可直接替换，均表积极充分利用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it is important for sb to do（从课文句长出）

advancedExpressions.example: It is important for you to make the most of our school resources. 你们充分利用学校资源很重要。（课文句型：it 作形式主语，真正主语是不定式，动作发出者用 for you）

advancedExpressions.expression: determined to make the most of every fleeting moment, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Determined to make the most of every fleeting moment, she filled her remaining days with laughter, with stories, with the kind of presence that said — without words — I am here, and I am grateful. （珍惜当下，时间紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I cannot urge you strongly enough to make the most of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I cannot urge you strongly enough to make the most of this reading programme — it is, without exaggeration, the kind of opportunity that can redefine your relationship with books. （推荐信）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ability to make the most of limited resources is ...
advancedExpressions.example: The ability to make the most of limited resources — to extract value from constraint rather than be defeated by it — is perhaps the single most underrated determinant of success.

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should make the most of our time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Time, she had learned, was not a resource to be managed but a gift to be spent — lavishly, deliberately, on the people and pursuits that set the soul alight. And so she made the most of every hour, not by cramming it with tasks, but by filling it with presence: the unhurried conversation, the walk taken slowly, the sunset watched all the way to darkness. （读后续写·时间哲学）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but...对比(resource vs gift) + 副词节奏(lavishly, deliberately) + 三重具体意象(unhurried conversation, walk, sunset)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Make the most of this chance.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would therefore urge every student to make the most of this chance — not merely to attend the workshops, but to immerse themselves fully: to ask the questions that feel too bold, to forge the friendships that might last a lifetime, and to leave with not just a certificate but a transformed perspective. （应用文·活动动员）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not merely to...but to...递进 + 三重不定式排比(to ask, to forge, to leave with)

definitionEn:
(1) n. [usually plural] a supply of something valuable, such as land, water, minerals or money, that a country, organization or person can use
(2) n. something, such as books, equipment or online material, that provides information or help for learning and teaching
(3) n. [plural] personal qualities, such as courage, imagination and determination, that help you deal with difficult situations
(4) v. (chiefly BrE) to provide an organization or activity with the money, equipment or staff it needs

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用于学习/教学的）资料，参考材料（如书籍、设备、网上材料）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher shared some useful online resources for exam revision. 老师分享了一些有用的在线备考资料。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数）应变的智谋与内在力量（个人品质，如勇气、想象力）
uncommonMeanings.example: Stranded on the mountainside with night closing in, Emma had nothing to rely on but her own inner resources — calm thinking, a pocketknife, and a stubborn refusal to panic. （读后续写·野外遇险·心理描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 为…提供资金（或设备、人员）（英式用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The after-school reading corner, generously resourced by local businesses, has grown from a single bookshelf into a small library that children queue up to enter. （应用文·感谢信/社区报道）

readingExamples: To fully realize your potential, it is important for you to make the most of our school resources.

posExamples.sentence: The old fisherman taught me that the sea is a generous but limited resource, handing me one small fish and releasing the rest with a gentleness I would never forget. （读后续写·祖辈教诲·动作细节）
I would like to suggest that our library open its digital resources to all students at weekends, so that those without computers at home will not be left behind. （应用文·建议信）
Time, unlike money or minerals, is a resource that can never be recycled; how we spend our eighteenth year determines, in large part, who we become at eighty. （议论文·珍惜时间）

No civilization, however advanced its technology, can afford to squander the natural resources on which its very survival depends — a lesson written plainly in the ruins of ancient empires. （议论文·可持续发展）

wordForms.noun: resource（资源，常用复数 resources）; resourcefulness（足智多谋）
wordForms.adjective: resourceful（足智多谋的，善于随机应变的）
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-(再)+source(来源)→可再取用之物→资源；"资源"义几乎总用复数 resources（natural/human/school resources）；形义辨析 resource(资源) vs source(来源)——多一个 re-，勿混；派生形容词 resourceful 足智多谋（-ful 表"充满"）；固定搭配 be thrown back on one's own resources 被迫自力更生

idioms.idiom: be thrown back on one's own resources
idioms.translation: 只能依靠自己，被迫自力更生
idioms.example: With no signal and no map, the hikers were thrown back on their own resources, navigating by the sun and the moss on the north side of the trees. （读后续写·困境求生）

collocations.translation: 学校资源（课文原句词块；resource 作"资源"义常用复数）
collocations.example: Make the most of our school resources. 充分利用我们的学校资源。（课文原句）
We must protect our natural resources for future generations. 我们必须为子孙后代保护自然资源。
After graduation, my cousin joined the human resources department, where her daily job is to match the right people with the right posts. （应用文·人物介绍）
Precisely because our resources are limited, every drop of water saved in the school canteen is a quiet vote for the planet's future. （议论文·节约主题）

collocations.phrase: make full use of / make the most of resources
collocations.example: To prepare for the contest, she made full use of every resource available — past papers, online lectures, and even lunchtime chats with her teachers. （读后续写·备赛励志）
The two schools decided to pool their resources, sharing laboratories and libraries so that students on both campuses could benefit equally. （应用文·合作倡议）
Our seniors' life experience is a precious resource that no search engine can replace, which is why our club records their oral histories every weekend. （应用文·社团活动介绍）
The school website has uploaded abundant learning resources, including recorded lessons and interactive exercises, free for every student to download. （应用文·通知）
Turning off an idle screen may seem trivial, but a habit multiplied by a billion people conserves resources on a scale no single power plant can match. （议论文·环保论证）

synonyms.translation: 来源，出处；根源（形义易混）
synonyms.example: The sun is the ultimate source of energy for all life on Earth. 太阳是地球上一切生命能量的终极来源。
synonyms.usage: 形义辨析(高频易混)：source 指"来源/出处/根源"（a source of income/information；the source of the river 河的源头）；resource 指"可利用的资源/储备"（natural/human resources）。记忆：re-source "再取用"→资源；source 是水从哪来，resource 是能用的水。

synonyms.example: Her fluency in three languages proved a tremendous asset when the international guests arrived without an interpreter. （读后续写·关键时刻）
synonyms.usage: asset 强调"对人或组织构成优势的财富"，可以指人；resource 强调"可取用的储备"，一般不直接指人

synonyms.example: For many rural children, the scholarship is the only means by which the dream of college can ever be reached. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: means 指达到目的的"途径、手段"，单复数同形（by means of）；resource 是被利用的"资源"本身

synonyms.example: The country keeps a strategic reserve of grain so that no natural disaster can shake the stability of its food supply. （议论文·粮食安全）
synonyms.usage: reserve 强调"特意留作备用"的储备量（石油储备、外汇储备）；resource 泛指一切可利用之物，不含"备用"之意

advancedExpressions.expression: natural / human / learning resources / limited resources / make the most of resources / inner resources / resourceful
advancedExpressions.example: A resourceful student makes the most of limited resources, drawing on both the school's learning resources and her own inner resources. （一句串联复数搭配、"内在智谋"义与派生形容词 resourceful）

advancedExpressions.expression: source（来源）+ re-（再）→ resource（可再取用之物=资源）；resource → resourceful（足智多谋的）
advancedExpressions.example: Water from that mountain source became the village's most precious resource, and only the most resourceful farmers made full use of it. （source 源头 → resource 资源 → resourceful 机智，三词一句辨清）

advancedExpressions.expression: Drawing on every resource within her/him, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Drawing on every resource within her — her wits, her training, and the memory of her coach's calm voice — Lily steadied the boat and steered it toward the fading light of the shore. （现在分词开头+破折号三项列举，续写高潮段的蓄力句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is the shared duty of ... to make the most of ... resources while wasting none
advancedExpressions.example: It is the shared duty of every student to make the most of our school's resources while wasting none, for the library's true wealth lies not on its shelves but in our hands. （倡议书结尾·职责句+对比升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is not merely a resource to be consumed, but a legacy to be preserved
advancedExpressions.example: Clean air is not merely a resource to be consumed, but a legacy to be preserved — borrowed, as the saying goes, from our children rather than inherited from our ancestors. （not merely...but 平行结构+化用谚语，论证收束）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use school resources well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only by making the most of the resources around us — attentive teachers, well-stocked shelves and open-minded classmates — can we turn three short years of senior high into a lifetime's foundation. （应用文·演讲稿）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only by...can 部分倒装 + 破折号三项列举具体化"资源" + 时间对比(three short years / a lifetime)制造格局感

sentenceUpgrade.original: She used her resources to solve the problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Refusing to admit defeat, she summoned every resource at her disposal, and piece by piece the seemingly unsolvable puzzle yielded to her quiet persistence. （读后续写·攻坚克难）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Refusing 现在分词表伴随心理 + at one's disposal 高级搭配 + 拟人(puzzle yielded) + piece by piece 副词控制节奏

classPractice.question: 充分利用我们的学校资源很重要。It is important to make the most of our school ____.

classPractice.question: The sun is the ultimate ____ (source / resource) of light and heat for the earth.

classPractice.note: 此处需形容词 resourceful 足智多谋的（-ful 后缀）；resource 是名词

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to make good use of an opportunity or available resource
(2) phr. (in a negative sense) to exploit someone's weakness or a situation unfairly for personal gain

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（中性）利用（机会、条件、资源），善加运用（课文义：take advantage of your classes）
uncommonMeanings.example: She took advantage of the free library to read everything she could reach. 她利用免费图书馆读遍了能拿到的一切书。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（贬义）利用某人，占某人的便宜（take advantage of sb.）
uncommonMeanings.example: She had never been able to say no — a kindness that others had learned, over the years, to take advantage of with a casual ruthlessness that chipped away at her spirit. （读后续写·人际关系·伤害）

readingExamples: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities.

posExamples.sentence: She took full advantage of the silence that settled over the house after midnight — it was in these hours, with only the moon as her witness, that she wrote the novel she had dreamed of since childhood. （读后续写·追梦场景）
I would like to encourage every member to take advantage of the online learning platform — it offers courses from world-class institutions, entirely free of charge. （应用文·通知/公告）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（充分）利用（机会/资源），善加运用；也指占……的便宜
collocations.example: You should take full advantage of the free courses offered by the school. 你应充分利用学校提供的免费课程。
Young workers tend to be at an advantage when applying for jobs. 年轻工人在求职时往往处于有利地位。
It might be to his advantage to take a computer course of some kind. 上一门电脑课程也许对他有利。

collocations.phrase: have / gain an advantage over sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】比某人有优势，胜过某人
collocations.example: His diligence gives him an advantage over the other applicants, which means he has an advantage over his opponent. 他的勤奋使他胜过其他求职者，意味着他比对手更有优势。

collocations.translation: 充分利用你们的课程（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习，并利用好学校设施。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make use of our school facilities
collocations.translation: 利用好学校设施（课文原句词块；同义替换 take advantage of）
collocations.example: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习，并利用好学校设施。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: take advantage of the opportunity to do sth
collocations.translation: 抓住机会做某事（中性·利用机会）
collocations.example: Take advantage of the opportunity to ask questions after class. 要抓住机会在课后提问。
Don't let others take advantage of your kindness. 别让别人利用你的善良。

He took full advantage of the summer break — rising before the sun to train, poring over books by lamplight, determined to return in September as a version of himself that no one would recognize. （读后续写·自我蜕变）

While others panicked in the chaos, she kept her head and took advantage of the situation — identifying needs, organizing help, and quietly becoming the leader no one had expected her to be. （读后续写·危机中凸显品质）
He had taken unfair advantage of her trust — a betrayal that cut deeper than any lie, because it had been dressed in the costume of friendship. （读后续写·背叛主题）

Years of living abroad had given him an accent and a perspective that his peers could not match; he didn't flaunt it, but he quietly knew he had an advantage over every other candidate in the room. （读后续写·竞争/面试场景）

With her fluent French and intimate knowledge of the city, she found herself at an advantage during the international conference, smoothly navigating conversations that left her colleagues stumbling. （读后续写·人物能力展示）

The change in the schedule worked entirely to her advantage — the extra hour before the interview gave her time to compose herself, to rehearse the answers she had lain awake worrying about. （读后续写·机遇降临）

synonyms.example: She learned to harness the fear that had once paralysed her, transforming it into a fuel that propelled her forward when exhaustion threatened to pull her under. （读后续写·情绪转化）
synonyms.usage: harness sth 强调把某种力量/情绪驾驭并转化为积极推动力，及物直接跟宾语；take advantage of 侧重"抓住并善用机会或资源"

synonyms.translation: 利用，开发（资源/机会/弱点）
synonyms.example: He had exploited every loophole, every grey area, every silence where a question should have been asked — and when it all came crashing down, no one was surprised except him. （读后续写·反派/教训类）
synonyms.usage: exploit 可褒（exploit resources 开发资源）可贬（exploit people 剥削他人），须看语境；take advantage of 的贬义仅限"占人便宜"，用于资源/机会时为中性

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·advantage 家族搭配（课件系统梳理）
advancedExpressions.expression: take (full / unfair) advantage of sth/sb（利用/占便宜）｜at an advantage（处于有利地位）｜to one's advantage（对某人有利）｜have / gain an advantage over sb（胜过某人）｜give sb an advantage over sb（使某人胜过……）。固定短语中 advantage 用单数、不加 s。
advancedExpressions.example: Taking full advantage of every free lesson put him at an advantage and gave him an advantage over his classmates when exams came. 充分利用每一节免费课让他占得先机，考试时比同学更有优势。

advancedExpressions.expression: take (full/unfair) advantage of / have an advantage over sb / at an advantage / to one's advantage / gain an advantage
advancedExpressions.example: He took full advantage of every free lesson, and that edge gave him a real advantage over his classmates when exams came. 他充分利用每一节免费课，考试时这份优势让他明显强过同学。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（利用/善用资源，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: take advantage of / make use of / make the most of / capitalize on / put ... to good use / cash in on
advancedExpressions.example: Make the most of your senior high years — take advantage of the classes and make good use of every facility around you. 好好把握高中三年，充分利用课程，用好身边每一处设施。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·祈使句并列（课文句型）
advancedExpressions.expression: Take ..., learn ..., and make use of ...（动词原形并列的祈使句，发出建议/号召）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文：Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 三个动词原形并列，是校长致辞式号召句的典型骨架。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. resolved to take advantage of the second chance that ...
advancedExpressions.example: She resolved to take advantage of the second chance that fate had so unexpectedly placed before her — this time, there would be no hesitation, no retreat, no looking back. （命运转折·决心表达，三重否定递进）

definitionEn:
(1) n. [usually plural] rooms, equipment or services that are provided for a particular purpose
(2) n. a place, especially a building, used for a particular activity or industry
(3) n. a natural ability to learn or do something easily and well
(4) n. an extra function or useful feature of a machine, system or service

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①天赋，才能（单数！a facility for sth = 学得又快又好的能力，高考爱考熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new student showed a rare facility for languages, slipping between English and French so effortlessly that even the teacher paused mid-sentence to listen. （读后续写·天才同学·侧面烘托）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（机器、系统的）特殊功能，附加功能

posExamples.sentence: The village school had no sports facilities to speak of — just a bare yard and a homemade wooden goal — yet the children's laughter there rang louder than in any stadium I had ever visited. （读后续写·乡村支教·对比描写）
I am writing to recommend our newly opened community centre, whose modern facilities, including a heated swimming pool and a well-equipped gym, are free to all residents over sixty. （应用文·推荐信）
First-class facilities alone do not make a first-class school; without devoted teachers and hungry minds, the shiniest laboratory is merely an expensive room with the lights left on. （议论文·教育本质）
Visitors are kindly reminded that the library's facilities, from self-service printers to group study rooms, may be booked in advance through the official app or at the front desk. （应用文·通知）

wordForms.noun: facility; facilitation（促进）; facilitator（促进者，引导者）
wordForms.adjective: facile（同源词：轻易的，肤浅的，含贬义）
wordForms.other: 小贴士：①"设施"义几乎总用复数 facilities（school/sports/public facilities）；单数 a facility 常表"天赋"(a facility for sth) 或"（系统的）功能"。②词根 facil-=easy（容易），故 facilitate=使容易→促进，facile=轻易的（贬）。③动词 facilitate 后直接跟宾语，不说 facilitate to do。

collocations.phrase: make use of our school facilities

collocations.example: Take advantage of your classes, learn from your teachers and classmates, and make use of our school facilities. 要充分利用课程，向老师和同学学习，并利用好学校设施。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: have a facility for sth（单数·天赋）

collocations.example: She has a facility for languages. 她有学语言的天赋。
The city plans to upgrade the sports facilities in every district park, giving joggers, dancers and basketball lovers alike a place to sweat. （应用文·新闻报道）
Treating public facilities with care is a quiet test of character that every citizen takes daily, whether or not anyone happens to be watching. （议论文·公民素养）
Mobile clinics now carry basic medical facilities into remote mountain villages, where a doctor's visit was once a once-a-year event. （应用文·医疗下乡报道）

collocations.translation: 现代化的／最先进的／一流的设施
collocations.example: Equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, the new science building allows students to conduct experiments that used to exist only in textbooks. （应用文·校园介绍）
The airport provides thoughtful facilities for passengers with disabilities, from step-free ramps to volunteer guides stationed at every corner. （应用文·服务介绍）
More companies are setting up childcare facilities in the workplace, an arrangement that eases young parents' minds and, in turn, boosts their efficiency. （议论文·职场与家庭）
Not everyone has a facility for numbers, but everyone can develop, through patient daily practice, a firm working friendship with them. （议论文·努力与天赋）

synonyms.example: The lab equipment must be checked and cleaned after each experiment, a rule our chemistry teacher enforces without a single exception. （应用文·规章说明）
synonyms.usage: equipment 指具体的器材装备，不可数名词，无复数；facilities 泛指成套的场地与配套服务，常用复数

synonyms.translation: 便利设施，生活福利设施
synonyms.example: The seaside town owes its popularity to its charming amenities: open-air cafés, free beach showers and a promenade lined with palm trees. （应用文·旅游介绍）
synonyms.usage: amenity 侧重让生活舒适愉快的配套（社区、酒店、城市宜居度），多用复数 amenities；facility 侧重实现某种功能的设施

synonyms.example: The concert venue was switched to the indoor stadium at the last minute because of the fast-approaching storm. （读后续写·突发变故）
synonyms.usage: venue 特指举办活动（比赛、演出、会议）的地点；facility 既可指场所，也可指其中的设备与服务

advancedExpressions.expression: make use of / provide / upgrade facilities；have a facility for sth（天赋）；facilitate sth（促进）；a facilitator（引导者）
advancedExpressions.example: The new lab not only provides first-class facilities but also facilitates hands-on learning. 新实验室不仅提供一流设施，还促进了动手学习。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（设施/设备，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: facilities / equipment / amenities / infrastructure / installations

advancedExpressions.expression: facile（轻易的，肤浅的）/ facility（便利；设施；天赋）/ facilitate（使容易→促进）/ facilitator（引导者）
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 facil- 意为 easy；facilitate 字面"使变容易"，即"促进、使便利"，是应用文里"促进交流/合作"的高级替换。

advancedExpressions.expression: For all its humble facilities, ... was rich in ...
advancedExpressions.example: For all its humble facilities, the mountain classroom was rich in what no money could buy: a curiosity that lit up forty pairs of eyes every single morning. （for all 让步+冒号解释，物质与精神的反差描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: Boasting ... facilities, ... offers sb. an ideal place to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Boasting first-class facilities and a warm atmosphere, our English corner offers every learner an ideal place to open their mouths and their minds. （boasting 分词开头+一语双关(open mouths and minds)，宣传稿亮点句）

advancedExpressions.expression: Facilities may set the stage, but it is ... that ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the glass-walled library flooded with morning light to the standard track that circles a green field, our school's facilities quietly invite every student to stretch both body and mind. （应用文·校园介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: from...to 空间列举铺开画面 + 环境细节(flooded with morning light) + 拟人(facilities invite) + body and mind 对仗收束

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: boasted no... 反语强化贫瘠 + yet 转折设置反差 + 抽象名词具体化(a hunger for knowledge) + put...to shame 高级表达

translation: adj. 相等的；平等的；相当的 | n. 同等的人（物）| vt. 比得上
definitionEn:
(1) adj. the same in size, amount, value, number, level, etc.
(2) adj. having the same rights, status, or opportunities
(3) adj. linking v. to be the same as or amount to
(4) vt. to be as good as or reach the same standard as something else

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】相当的，能胜任的（be equal to sth = a.和……一样好 b.胜任=be up to）
uncommonMeanings.example: The architecture here is equal to any in the world. 这里的建筑与世界上任何建筑相媲美。／ Are you equal to this job? 你能胜任这份工作吗？（=be up to）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】同等的人（物）；匹敌者（treat sb as equals 一视同仁；be without equal / have no equal 出类拔萃；be the equal of 可与……抗衡）
uncommonMeanings.example: He treated his staff as equals. 他对员工一视同仁。／ The company proved to be the equal of its US rivals. 该公司可与其美国竞争对手抗衡。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①相等的，同样的（the same in size/amount/value；the same rights 平等的）
uncommonMeanings.example: Women demanded equal pay for equal work. 妇女要求同工同酬。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②等于；比得上，与……相当（Two plus two equals four.）
uncommonMeanings.example: No one can equal her in patience. 论耐心谁也比不上她。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③同等的人或事物；匹敌者
uncommonMeanings.example: In the world of ancient Chinese painting, this scroll had no equal — a fact that every museum director in the world understood the moment it was unveiled. （读后续写·无与伦比）

readingExamples: Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude.

posExamples.sentence: As they stood side by side on the starting line — the rich boy in his expensive shoes and the village girl in her worn-out sneakers — an unspoken understanding passed between them: on this track, at least, they were equals. （读后续写·平等主题·体育场景）
I am confident that my dedication, combined with the experience I have gained over the past two years, equals — if not surpasses — the requirements outlined in your announcement. （应用文·自荐信/申请信）

wordForms.verb: equalize（使平等，使相等）; equal（等于，比得上）
wordForms.other: inequality（不平等） / unequal（不平等的）；小贴士：①equal 作动词时过去式英式 equalled、美式 equaled。②be equal to sth 有"等于"和"胜任"两义，靠语境判断。③课文 Of equal importance are... 为"表语(介词短语)居首→完全倒装"，主语是复数 good study habits... 故用 are。

idioms.example: For the first time, he was speaking to his father on equal terms — not as a child seeking approval, but as one adult to another, each with his own hard-won wisdom. （读后续写·父子关系·成长标志）

collocations.phrase: be equal to sth【课件】（a.比得上，和……一样好 b.胜任，能应付=be up to）
collocations.translation: 【课件】① to be as good as sth 比得上，和……一样好；② to have the ability to deal with a problem/piece of work successfully 胜任，能应付（=be up to）
collocations.example: 【课件】The architecture here is equal to any in the world. 这里的建筑与世界上任何地方的建筑相媲美。／ Are you equal to this job? 你能胜任这项工作吗？

collocations.phrase: be equal in size / length / height【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】在大小/长度/高度上相等（=of equal size / value / importance）

collocations.phrase: All men are created equal.【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】人人生而平等（equal 作宾补，表"平等的"）
collocations.example: 【课件】All men are created equal. 人人生而平等。

collocations.phrase: treat sb as equals / as an equal【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】平等相待，一视同仁（n. 同等的人）
collocations.example: 【课件】He treated his staff as equals. 他对员工一视同仁。

collocations.phrase: be without equal / have no equal【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】出类拔萃，首屈一指，无人能及（n. 匹敌者）
collocations.example: 【课件】She is a musician without equal / who has no equal. 她是一位无与伦比的音乐家。

collocations.phrase: be the equal of sb / sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】可与……抗衡，比得上（n. 同等之物）
collocations.example: 【课件】The company proved to be the equal of its US rivals. 事实证明该公司可与其美国竞争对手抗衡。

collocations.phrase: equal sth (vt. 与……相等；比得上)【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】vt. 与……相等；比得上（No amount of ... can equal ...）
collocations.example: 【课件】No amount of money can equal memories like that. 再多的金钱也比不上那样的记忆。

collocations.phrase: Of equal importance are ...（表语居首完全倒装）
collocations.translation: 同样重要的是……（课文原句词块）

collocations.translation: 等于；胜任，能应付（be equal to the task 胜任这项任务）
collocations.example: I'm sure she is equal to the task. 我相信她能胜任这项任务。
The two boxes are equal in size and weight. 这两个盒子大小和重量相等。
The doctors warned that the surgery would test her to the limit — but she proved equal to it, emerging from the ordeal with a gratitude for life that she had never known before. （读后续写·疾病·康复）
I believe our club should operate on the principle of equal opportunity — every voice, regardless of seniority, deserves to be heard and respected. （应用文·倡议/演讲）

synonyms.example: One kilometre is roughly equivalent to two thousand paces. 一公里大约相当于两千步。
synonyms.usage: 常作 be equivalent to sth，强调功能或价值上对等（可作 adj. 也可作 n.）；equal 更强调数量/地位上的"相等、平等"，也可作动词 equal sth

synonyms.example: No one could match her energy, her refusal to give up, her ability to find hope in situations where hope seemed the most irrational choice of all. （读后续写·人物赞颂）
synonyms.usage: match sb (in sth) 侧重在能力/品质上匹敌，及物直接跟宾语；equal 作"比得上"时同样及物 equal sb (in sth)，但更常用于数值"等于"

synonyms.translation: 完全相同的，一模一样的
synonyms.example: The twins wore identical uniforms. 这对双胞胎穿着一模一样的校服。
synonyms.usage: be identical to/with sth，强调"完全一致、毫无差别"；equal 强调"数量或地位上相等"，不等于"一模一样"（equal ≠ identical，可作议论文辨析亮点）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·完全倒装（表语/地点介词短语居首→主谓完全倒装，课文核心句式）
advancedExpressions.expression: ① 表语（介词短语/形容词）居首 + be + 主语：Of equal importance are ...（主语较长时用完全倒装使句子平衡）② 表地点的介词短语 + be/live/stand/lie + 主语（主语为名词）③ Here/There/Now/Then/Out/In/Up/Down/Away/Off + come/go/rush + 主语（谓语为表位移动词，主语为名词）④ There + be/live/fly/lie/stand/remain + 主语（表某地有某物）★注意：主语是代词则主谓不倒装；完全倒装时谓语单复数取决于后面的真实主语
advancedExpressions.example: 课文①：Of equal importance are good study habits, useful skills and a positive attitude. 同样重要的是良好的学习习惯、实用的技能和积极的态度。（主语较长，用完全倒装使句子更平衡；主语复数→谓语用 are）

advancedExpressions.type: 语境应用·完全倒装（课件原题）
advancedExpressions.expression: 地点介词短语居首 + be + 主语（名词）→ 完全倒装
advancedExpressions.example: 1. 教室里有四十名中国学生和两名老师。In the classroom are forty Chinese students and two teachers. 2. 在这张照片中，我周围都是那时在我生活中很重要的东西：汽车杂志和乐器。Around me in this picture are the things that were very important in my life at that time: car magazines and musical instruments.（谓语 are 与后置的真实主语 the things 一致）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·表语居首的完全倒装（课文句型）

advancedExpressions.expression: be equal to sth（等于/胜任）/ on equal terms（平等地）/ equal opportunity（平等机会）/ without equal（无与伦比）/ treat sb as an equal（平等相待）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（相等/平等，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be equal to / be equivalent to / be the same as / amount to / be on a par with / be on equal footing with

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, they met as equals

advancedExpressions.expression: I firmly believe that every student should be treated as an equal

advancedExpressions.expression: equal does not mean identical; it means ...

posExamples.sentence: What struck me most about Grandpa was his attitude towards setbacks: whenever a crop failed, he would simply tip back his straw hat, study the sky, and say, 'The land forgives those who try again.' （读后续写·祖辈智慧·语言描写）
I strongly recommend Li Hua for the exchange programme, for his positive attitude towards challenges has inspired everyone in our class to push beyond their comfort zones. （应用文·推荐信）

Let us adopt a responsible attitude towards rubbish sorting, for the habit of one household, multiplied by millions, reshapes the face of a city and the future of a planet. （应用文·倡议书）

idioms.example: The new waiter was said to have an attitude problem, yet Mrs. Lee noticed that his rudeness melted away the moment anyone asked about his little daughter. （读后续写·误解与理解）

Faced with the strangers' mockery, Tom adopted a calm attitude, bent down without a word, and went on picking up the scattered litter. （读后续写·以行动回应）

Grandma's attitude towards life was written in her garden: whatever the winter took away, she calmly planted again in spring. （读后续写·人物象征）

collocations.translation: 漫不经心的／从容的态度
collocations.example: A casual attitude towards traffic rules costs lives; a moment's convenience at a red light may become a lifetime's regret. （议论文·规则意识）
The books we read in adolescence quietly shape our attitudes long after their plots have been forgotten. （议论文·阅读的意义）

synonyms.usage: stance 指就争议问题公开表明的正式立场（take a stance on/against），多用于机构、政策语境；attitude 更私人化、日常化

synonyms.usage: perspective 强调观察问题的角度，可随立足点转换（from the perspective of）；attitude 含情感与评价色彩，相对稳定
